main_text.p: tum referendum inquit: Non enim ficus aut mori, inquit, realis species, sed spiritalis tantum ad uterum fertur. Non ergo hilce cafibus per atomos ex fructu emanantes ejusmodi stigma oboritur. Et si quidem fructus ipse quandoque maternum corpus contingat, non tamen per atomorum e fructu diffusionem in corpus maternum, indeque in foetum, ejusmodi effectum producit; sed exci tata imaginatione, de cujus Viribus forte in progressu videbimus. Sane fructus ejusmodi haud adeo volatiles atomos continent, qui ita subito corpori se queant communicare: Et si forte atomi ex ejusmodi fructibus tam copiosae emanarent, seque in corpus maternum infinuarent, oporteret totum corpus maternum conlimiliter afficerent, atque totum Aurum a Mercurio affici-tur, non in corpus demum foetus, & qui dem certa duntaxat in parte illius, impressionem efficerent. Et quid ni illi fructus, (v. g. mora vel fraga,) exp lu-rimis

page.notes: Several words are doubtful in the scan due to blur and show-through; the line "Et si quidem fructus ipse quandoque..." and the Latin in the middle lines were read with some uncertainty. Lines near "Aurum a Mercurio" and "exp lu-rimis" (expluirimis / explurimis) are partly illegible; transcribed as best read. Page number printed as "§ 21" (ornamented 21 at top right).
